phase1_classification.kind_reason: Proposed benchmark suite for intervention quality of conversational memory with four tracks (unprompted tension detection, draft alignment, belief supersession, safe recall) built on LoCoMo multi-session corpora; only Track B (161 items) is instantiated and human-validated in this paper.
